parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic. It is small and ergonomically shaped for finger pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as the actuator that, when pressed, pumps liquid from the bottle through the nozzle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns upward via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of polyethylene plastic. It is cylindrical and holds the liquid content.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid (such as soap or lotion) and supports the pump mechanism on top.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use and does not move relative to the pressing lid.
